verdict.rationale: Cekura ships a first-party plugin that bundles Skills, slash commands and MCP config (13 Skills, 14 Commands). It is built so AI assistants such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Copilot can design, run and improve voice-agent evaluations and manage testing and observability from plain-language prompts. Separately, LLM-judge metrics let users define success criteria in plain English. Missing for 10: a native natural-language interface inside the Cekura product itself (operation depends on an external AI assistant), detailed docs on which operations are covered by natural-language commands, and independent hands-on corroboration of the skills/MCP workflow.
